how_to_apply: Visit the official BEML website at bemlindia.in.
Open the Careers section of the website.
Look for Advertisement No. KP/S/20/2026 for ITI Trainee (Fitter and Electrician) posts.
Download and read the detailed recruitment notification.
Check the educational qualification, experience, age limit and other eligibility conditions.
Click the "Apply ON-LINE" link on the BEML Careers page.
Complete the registration process as instructed on the recruitment portal.
Fill in the required personal, educational and experience details.

Upload the prescribed documents (10th marks card, ITI certificate and marks sheets, NAC, experience certificates, Government ID, category certificate if applicable, fee challan and detailed resume), photograph and signature.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 200 online (GEN/EWS/OBC); SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempt.
Review the completed application form and submit it before 18:00 hrs on 6 December 2026.
Download or print the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: BEML ITI Trainee Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: BEML has announced 44 ITI Trainee vacancies for candidates with experience in the Rail and Metro sector. The vacancies are divided between the Fitter and Electrician trades. The post-wise details are provided below: The ITI Trainee (Electrician) trade has 27 vacancies, while the Fitter trade has 17 vacancies. The category-wise distribution is: Fitter - UR 9, OBC 4, SC 2, ST 1, EWS 1; Electrician - UR 12, OBC 7, SC 5, ST 2, EWS 1.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: ITI Trainee (Fitter): First Class (60%) ITI in the Fitter trade with National Trade Certificate (NTC) issued by NCVT and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by DGT, plus minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in maintenance of rolling stock (Railways & Metro). ITI Trainee (Electrician): First Class (60%) ITI in the Electrician trade with National Trade Certificate (NTC) issued by NCVT and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by DGT, plus minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in maintenance of rolling stock (Railways & Metro). Experience: BEML is seeking personnel with experience in the Rail and Metro domain. Additional Eligibility: Apprenticeship with NAC is mandatory; minimum marks are 60% in ITI (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST/PwD); minimum 2 years of experience after apprenticeship, with no relaxation. Qualification and experience are counted as on 6 December 2026. Candidates must verify the complete educational qualifications and experience criteria before applying. The detailed notification requires minimum 60% marks in ITI and minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum and maximum age limits for BEML ITI Trainee Recruitment 2026 are given in the detailed notification dated 13 November 2026 as category-wise upper age limits, counted as on 6 December 2026. Minimum Age: To be confirmed. Maximum Age: 29 years for UR, 32 years for OBC, 34 years for SC/ST (relaxation included). Age Relaxation: PwD candidates (40% or above disability) get an additional 10 years over the upper age limit. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification for the category-wise age limit, age calculation date and applicable relaxations.

content_sections.heading: BEML ITI Trainee Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Training period (1 year): Rs. 15,500 per month (consolidated). Contract period (2 years): Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 23,500 per month. After absorption in Wage Group B: pay scale of Rs. 16,900-60,650 (subject to BEML's business requirements).

content_sections.heading: BEML ITI Trainee Application Fee
content_sections.text: GEN / EWS / OBC: Rs. 200 (non-refundable, paid online) SC / ST / PwD: No fee

content_sections.heading: BEML ITI Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on qualification, age, experience and category. Computer Based Written Test and/or Skill Test (50% weightage each). Written Test passing marks: 45% for UR/OBC/EWS, 40% for SC/ST/PwD. Skill Test passing marks: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD. Pre-employment medical examination and original document verification.
